scenarios.name: CdpSdkGuardrails
scenarios.checks: 9 PASS / 2 FAIL (11 scenarios, guardrails surface, offline): CANON happy-path PASS (guardrails attached, valid requirements pass through); CDP-unique defenses PASS — W-TIMEOUT (server-supplied 86400s validity window rejected: MAX_PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3600 hard cap bounds EIP-3009 validBefore; CF and Circle have no equivalent), W-MALFORMED (requirements carrying both amount (v2) and maxAmountRequired (v1) rejected — cross-version spoofing blocked), W-PAYEE (allowedPayees rejects attacker payTo — the W5 fix shape, opt-in), W-NETWORK and W-ASSET (allowlist aggregate filters reject foreign network/asset), W-DOUBLE-APPLY (second applySpendControls -> already_applied), W-NEG-AMOUNT (negative amount -> amount_unparseable), W-CAP1 (per-payment cap enforced when configured: SpendControlError(per_payment_cap)). FAIL: W-CAP2 (Medium, dust — amount=1 signed silently despite advertised $0.01, no min check, same as CF/Circle); W-NO-CONTROLS (High, CDP-unique default-unsafe — CdpX402Client extends x402Client and REMOVES the upstream default $1 per-payment cap: without applySpendControls, $2, attacker payTo and dust are all signed; constructor only console.warns). Windows inherited from the shared x402Client base (W2/W3/W4/W-MCP) are covered at SUT-1/SUT-2, not re-probed here; W-BATCH1/2/3 and live CdpX402Client out of offline scope per TZ. Fixation 2026-10-30T13:16:00Z.

findings_summary.title: CdpX402Client default-unsafe (SUT-3 CDP-unique): extends x402Client and removes its default $1 per-payment cap; without explicit applySpendControls, over-cap, attacker-payTo and dust amounts are all signed; the constructor only console.warns.
No minimum-amount check (all three SUTs): dust amounts (1 atomic = $0.000001 vs $0.01 advertised) are signed silently — combined with W1/W-CAP1 the whole amount range is unguarded by default.
